narrative:
First off I myself did not almost die.
This could be considered a STE. I was next to my mother for 5 days as she slowly died and this is a story of what I heard, saw, and felt as a psychic.
But first, A little background on me being psychic to explain a few things. Also, That I HAVE been to
Heaven before during meditation/astral projection?

(background)

I'm very psychic and have been for about 15 years especially after reading
“Who Were You?: A Do-It-Yourself Guide to Past Life Regression by Gloria
Chadwick. I wanted to know who I was in former lives and other things.
Once I read this book and completed many self guided hypnosis I was able to meditate/astral project myself into Heaven. Visit with my spirit guide. Go over my life’s plan and see what I was meant to work on in this life.
Since then I’ve done hundreds of private physic readings for people free of charge. I can tell how people died in past lives, what they did for a living, tell them how they got birth marks from trauma or battle from past lives. I’m able to tell people exactly how their relatives died as well.
I can pass along messages from the other side.
Even tell if someone was supposed to be a twin and their twin died at birth. I know that this is my 10th lifetime. I know every name I've ever been , where I lived in the world and have actually found one of my grave stones thousands of miles away from on online directly of the cemetery that came to me during a meditation with the exact names of birth and death of me and my children that I wrote down as soon as I was done mediating. Found them in
Appleton New Jersey. I’ve also been able to fluently speak different languages while in mediation and Google translate them once done. Some are languages that haven’t been spoke in hundreds of years.
I’ve done many podcasts from people all over north America and have been extremely accurate in readings in real time along with these podcasts and have made grown men cry the way I can tell them about their past on friends and family with very personal details only they would know.

While in Heaven during a mediation I’ve met my spirit guide. The one who designed my life before I left heaven to come down here and live it out. She is very dark skinned with a bald head.
She has the most beautiful smile with the biggest whitest teeth. Perfect dark skin. She kind of looks like the main female character from Black Panther:

Although I met her 14ish years ago well before Black Panther came out.
We met in Heaven or pre-Heaven at a white marble table with marble benches. There was a very bright white fog surrounding us at all times so I wasn’t able to see beyond our little marble table. There I asked many questions like “what am I supposed to be working on in this life?
She said I was supposed to work on being patient.
Funny because I am not a patient person whatsoever.
She also told me I was meant to shine and that after this I would be given psychic gifts and I had a feeling that if I used these psychic gifts I was not supposed to charge any money or ask anything for my time or service.
To which I have never to this day.
I see ghosts when I want or need to see them and then shut it off like a switch because it can be overwhelming seeing ghosts all the time.
I can feel residual energy from traumatic events and can tell the difference between live ghosts and residual energy.

Here is the story of what I witnessed while watching my mother die slowly over 5 days. I met the grim reaper, Jesus and then a demon disguised as a little kid all within about 12 hours before/after death.

So when i got the call that my mother had another series of mini strokes and was not getting better i had to travel to Florida and be her care taker in her final days what along with my sister who also is somewhat psychic.
My father was there as well.
My mother was a DNR, DNI and she had in her will that she didn't want to be intubated or use of a feeding tube. By the time I arrived my mother was not talking. She could see me but couldn’t speak.
She could react to pain and discomfort but not speak.
I was given morphine from a kit a palliative care nurse gave us to administer through her stomach feeding tube every few hours. No food or water was even allowed according to her will. We all knew she was going to pass, it was just a matter of how many days could she last without food or water.
No Heavenly phenomena happened until the final 24 hours.
In total it took her 5 days to pass once we stopped food and water and only gave morphine for pain.

I Met the Grim Reaper:

About 7-8 hours before her death (middle of the night approximately 2-3 am)
I saw a very tall, very thin, solid black figure. Approximately 7 feet tall carrying a briefcase and a top hat, walking from the back bedroom down the hall. He had no discernible facial features other than he would have had a skinny face and regular sized nose and a defined jaw line due to being so skinny and tall. He appeared from the back bedroom.
There was a bright white light coming from the room; but not from a light bulb in the room being turned on. It wasn’t as bright as God’s light; that light would show up later when Jesus arrived. Much like other accounts of
NDE’s where people mention a bright white light.
My mother’s hospital bed was in the middle of the living room in the same spot she had previously had her recliner in. The tall, solid black figure didn’t acknowledge me at all. The feeling I got from him was "a matter of fact.
No negative feelings or positive in any way, just, this is who I am and
I'm here to do a job with no emotional connection. The only way I can describe him is he looked like the Bad guy from the movie "Who framed Roger Rabbit"
Christopher Lloyd's character.

This man (figure) walked through the kitchen and around to my mom’s side of the bed. It was the middle of the night.
I was not scared, worried or threatened by this huge man.
You could not tell what race this figure was- he didn’t have one.
He was not a color other than a solid black figure.
I could tell he was wearing a very stiff suit as it did not sway as he walked. As he stood next to my mother towering over her, he opened his briefcase and took out a legal pad of paper. On this pad of paper had only a few words and a spot to make a check mark in.
It simply had my mother’s full married name: Trudie.

Her maiden name was W.
I thought that was kind of interesting that it had her married name and not her birth name. It had an empty square where you could assume a check mark would go, He took some type of writing tool either pen or pencil ( I can’t remember) and made a very clearly check mark in the empty square. He then took the legal pad and put it back in his brief case. Closed the briefcase and walked slowly to the back bedroom from which he originally came.
Again leaving just as he arrived with no emotion, not anger, not sadness, definitely not happy just “ a matter of fact”
As he left I still wasn’t scared or any negative emotion was attached.
Just simply witnessing him do this.
A minute or two after he left I asked my sister if she saw any of that.
My dad was right there as well but he’s not psychic at all and wouldn’t clue into any psychic phenomena. My sister didn’t see anything. I told her exactly what I saw because at the time I didn’t know what that was, When I explained what I saw she said “ O MY GOD” you just saw the grim reaper.
He came before her death to collect her name.
Like a pre-flight to Heaven check to see if he was going to get the right person in a matter of a few hours.
Whether he was the grim reaper or just someone that checks in on the soon-to –be dead I’m not sure. Everyone seems to know that stereo typical grim reaper with the hood-cloak and curved staff.
Perhaps that grim reaper is only for those who were evil or not worthy just yet of Gods forgiveness.

My sister didn’t see any of that but she told me later that she heard this exact musical excerpt a few hours before the grim reaper came and lasted a least a few hours. Playing over and over. It was on a instrument she can’t quite describe but said it was some type of keyboard mixed with a flute or clarinet sound.

I’ve listened to NDR podcasts and lots of people say they hear music but never seem to be able to sing it back or write it down so hear is what my sister heard. It won't let me paste the music screen shot I made into your website but I'd love to send it at some point!!!

After the Grim reaper checked her name off within a hour or so both me and my sister could see my mother’s soul leave her body. She walked through the kitchen and head down the hallway to the same back bedroom that the grim reaper came and went. She still seemed confused though. As if she was still stuck with her same stoke ridden mind and she began to look confused at the doorway emitting that beautiful white pure Heavenly light. She seemed scared to go into this light. She looked around. I could sense her confusion and apprehension as if she didn’t want to go where the grim reaper just went back to although she knew it would lead to somewhere good.
She never said anything, she just simply walked back down the hall and through the kitchen and reentered her dying, tired, stroke ridden, starved of food and water body. We were very upset that she would even want to head back into her body after temporarily being free.

An hour or so later after she reentered her body was the last few hours of her life. Soon she would meet Jesus and have no choice but to go with him

This is where We met JESUS!!

At approximately 6 am, before the sun came up is when we met Jesus.
Sunrise that day wasn’t going to come until 7:21 am.
Five hours before her heart stopped is when we were all gathered around her bed. I was facing her bed with the door to the lanai (inside screen porch in Florida) to my back.
My sister was standing next to me and we both could feel and see with our psychic minds the brightest light that could possibly exist behind us. My father could not see the light but knew something extremely significant was happening, the light was not coming from the sun’s rays as it was before sunrise.
I still faced my mother but turned my head over my shoulder and could see
Jesus standing behind me. His body was emitting this light. Every part of him that was skin was pure light.
He was wearing an off white or the lightest tan robe.
You could hardly tell what color robe he was wearing because it was so close to the shade of white his own light was emitting, I was not directly facing him so I couldn’t see all of him.
Both me and my sister could not see his feet.
I know that has been a theme in a lot of peoples NDE’s and it was the same with us. I wanted to look directly at him but I wanted to keep an eye on my mom.
His robe and hair were very flowing as if being blown by a large fan from all around and yet there was no breeze coming through the screened in porch.
I could see his hair and beard. It was a sandy reddish brown.
I could not see his eyes. I wish I could have. His whole face except facial hair was just simply pure bright white light. I think perhaps if I was the one actually dying he would have let me see his whole face.
My sister standing next me saw Jesus' entire body ( feet not included)
including his face. I asked her much later what did he look like. She mentioned he looked almost exactly like the stereo type Christian picture that 99% of Catholic churches use.
She thinks that perhaps he appeared that way to her because that is what she was expecting him to look like due to a lifetime of seeing that widely used picture of him:

Once we saw Jesus we knew he was coming for my mother. We aggressively tried to persuade my mom to go with Jesus and it’s time to go.
“You can’t say no to JESUS!
He was there and there was no doubt she had to go.
Jesus never said anything while he was there but it was crystal clear in our minds he was there to take my mother to Heaven. My dad actually piped up for once in 5 days and with tears in his eyes told her she had to go be with Jesus.
It’s hard to let someone go if you‘ve been together for 50 years as my parents were.

We felt my mother’s soul leave her body and go towards the light with Jesus.
We could look back at her body and it was still breathing.
She would continue to slowly take labored breathes for about 4-5 hours but we didn’t feel a sense of her soul being there.
Many people say that the soul leaves the body before actually death so you don’t feel the uncomfortable-ness of actual death.
I believe this was the case.
My mother took her last breath at 11 am.
Jesus had taken her around 6 am.
There was a sense of relief when she actually passed. I had flown to
Florida to administer end of life care in her final days and was happy when she wasn’t breathing anymore. She wasn’t going to be in pain anymore and I knew she would go Heaven and be immediately young, vibrant and not be confused that way she spent the last 7 years after she had her initial stroke.

A few hours later we met a demon!

When the men from the funeral home came to prepare her body for transport I thought that was end of the Heavenly- spiritual phenomenon. However about 20 minutes after they picked up her body I went back to that back bedroom where the
Grim Reaper had appeared just a few hours earlier.
I sensed the magnitude of the events that just happened and could feel residual energy from the portal that had been opened up for the grim reaper to enter. I could sense it came from the closet in that back bedroom. I could feel this powerful energy but couldn’t tell if it were positive or negative energy. All of a sudden I heard a child’s voice from the closet.,
I didn’t hear it aloud but could hear it in my head the way I hear ghosts speak to me and can relay messages.
This small child about the age of 4-6 was crouching in the corner of the closet.
Begging and pleading for help.
Wanted to “be let in.”
I had a weird suspicion about this entity.
I didn’t fully trust this child. Without saying a word I called my sister to the back bedroom to ask her what she felt, if anything.
I didn’t tell her what I just heard or saw. I wanted to know if she could pick up on what I was seeing and hearing.
She too could sense a small child, desperately trying to get our attention and be given permission to enter the rest of the bedroom and not be stuck in this closet. I immediately thought to myself that demons or bad ghosts need permission to enter whereas non evil spirits can simply roam free as long as they don’t interrupt the daily lives of the living. After this revelation of what this child really was,
It decided to show us what it really looked like under this pretend child’s body and persona and innocent sounding plea to be let out,
It was a grotesque small creature much like a gremlin but far more hideous. We worked together to imagine pure white light surrounding and encompassing the entire building that housed my parents condo and pushed this demon out of the condo, Using the Lord’s
Prayer as well as saying “The light of God protects us and this house” over and over again until we felt the original white light that had been opened by the grim reaper leave and be replaced with Gods white light like a parachute that was healing, protecting and guarding against any unwanted spirit.
After this demon-like spirit left we all felt a sense of wellbeing in my parents place and didn’t feel my mother’s presence until her funeral a few short days later when we could hear her sing along with the hymns played at her service.

I have many more stories after this account including when my mother warned me of my father’s death a year and a half later but I’ll leave that for possibly another time on this website.

I hope you enjoyed a psychic’s account from watching their parent pass away and what I saw, heard and felt. I am not afraid of death in any way. I'm not looking forward to it but I know it will be a great reunion-party with everyone who has past before me.

I’d like to end my story with lyrics from a well known song that Gonzo sang in the Muppet movie that goes way deeper than a kids movie. The song is all about
Heaven and 100% true!

This looks familiar, vaguely familiar,

Almost unreal, yet, it's too soon to feel yet.

Close to my soul, yet so far away.

I'm going to go back there someday.

Sun rises, night falls, sometimes the sky calls.

Is that a song there, and do I belong there?

I've never been there, but I know the way.

I'm going to go back there someday.

There's not a word yet for old friends who've just met.

Part heaven, part space, or have I found my place?

You can just visit, but I plan to stay.

I'm going to go back there someday.

I'm going to go back there someday.

We all started in Heaven and will all “ go back there someday!”

1 April 2003 was the first time he appeared in my dream. He seemed very confused and disoriented. In my dream his lips were sealed (this was because of what the funeral home had done for the wake) and then he pried his lips open and was able to speak. I remember saying to him that he has scared everyone as we thought he had died. Since then he has appeared in my dreams almost daily. Then one day I smelt coffee brewing in the house it was 9.30 at night, I don't have a coffee machine. I asked my mum if she can smell coffee and she said she could. The next day I spoke with Tim's mum and she said she experienced the same thing as she was vacuuming the hallway she smelt coffee brewing in Tim's bathroom but there was no coffee there of course. His mum lives in Chicago I live in Sydney Australia.

A few things have happened like a bottle of liquid soap went missing mysteriously from our kitchen sink. My mum and I could smell someone smoking behind us when we would go for walks but there would be no one behind us. I have had 2 frights from him, once he spoke to me and it gave me such a fright as i was in a deep sleep I screamed and woke everyone up. The following week I was awoken by a black aberration floating above me when I was a sleep it terrified me - this happened about 2 weeks ago. Since then I have slept with the light on and I have asked that he no longer contact me that way again as it is scaring me.

I have only seen him in my dreams a couple of times since that experience. Out of nowhere the ropes of the window blind would hit the blind and start swinging at night - my daughter witnessed this also. When I returned to Sydney after the funeral my mum would hear him talking to my birds as she opened the door to our home.

Oliver, my son, was an officer in the Navy. However, he was no longer happy there. He was being harassed by subordinates, and on Valentine’s Day, his girlfriend left him. She took a few things at first, then returned later while he was at work and completely cleaned out the apartment.

When Oliver came home, he found his apartment empty—on top of dealing with the harassment at his job. His mother and I were not together, but I would have him almost every weekend. Over the years, we spent hundreds of hours in my bedroom, watching my flat-screen TV together.

On February 17, Oliver took his own life. He was discovered on February 18, and I was informed on February 19. I suffer from serious medical problems and cannot sleep for more than 2-3 hours at a time due to terrible pain.

On the night of February 17,
I was asleep, lying on my side with my back to the room. Suddenly, I felt a strong tug—three or four times—pulling on my shoulders, as if someone was trying to wake me up and get me to roll over. It felt physical and real. I woke up feeling completely alert but didn’t think much of it at the time and went back to sleep.

Thirty-six hours later, I learned what had happened. A few hours after receiving the news, I connected the two events in my mind.

Then, on February 22, the TV that Oliver and I used to watch together started flickering on and off for a couple of hours. It had never done that before. I tried everything to fix it, and eventually, it just started working again—same room, same TV.

I don’t have much of a social life—no bars, no woman, just a very small group of friends. I rarely receive phone calls. In fact, I’ve often wondered why I even keep a phone.

Late at night on February 22, I opened your site, ADCRF, and began reading a little. Just as I started, my phone rang—only once. It was 2:30 a.m. I checked the caller ID, but it was completely blank.

I believe in ADC (After-Death Communication). I believe it was Oliver. I wish he would continue reaching out.

I love you, Oliver.

My mom died in March of this year and I have been really sad because it was unexpected. I was sitting on my bed by myself my dad and stepmom are upstairs sleeping and the light turned on for the entire bedroom out of nowhere. Then I was in the garage by myself smoking at night and the lights were flickering a lot I just thought it was kind of strange then at a separate event I was downstairs in my bed and the lights were flickering a lot I kept telling myself that it was just something with the electrical in the house. Then I was sitting outside and I heard my mom say my name out loud. Earlier this week when I was home alone something was wrong or I heard a loud bang upstairs, no one home nothing there...

My patient was close to death. She had promised her favorite nurse that she would wait for her to return to work before dying.

While this nurse was gone for two days, My patient was in a morphine induced coma. While I assumed she was asleep and I would be speaking to her higher self, I said:
"Charlotte, your husband is doing fine with his heart diet and your daughter is married to a wonderful man. Why don't you just go ahead and let go." From out of her coma, she said " I can't". As far as I know, she never spoke again.
Two hours after I went home, I got a phone call that she had passed away.

I went to sleep soon after that and had the following dream:

I was sitting next to the bed where Charlotte was wrapped in linen from head to toe.
It was a hospital room. Something made me go over to her and look down at her face wherein her eyes had mysteriously been uncovered and black eyeliner was around her eyes. She said "I'm not dead, What should I do? I said that I would help her as best I could and transported her to an ambulance. I said that she would be ferried while in the ambulance "to the other side". She asked if her husband could go with her. I said he could ride in the ambulance but that he would have to return in it also.

She thanked me and the dream ended. I spoke to some trusted friends and my mother who all agreed that it may have been possible that she reached out to me because
I demonstrated that (to her) I knew what I was talking about.

Cannot remember event. I do know through out my life I have felt separate from the world. I did not care about money. It is still not an issue for me. If I am comfortable and our needs are met I am fine. I do not care to spend my time in the pursuit of money. My children have always been my number one priority. My grandchildren are too. Spiritual growth has always been important to me. I know beyond doubt a spiritual world exists. I know my relatives are waiting for me.
I have experienced a visit from my grandmother the night of her death. I was in AZ, she in Ky. I could not afford to travel at the time. My heart was heavy. I was in bed almost asleep. I felt my self overlooking a beautiful valley filled with gorgeous light purple flowers. I could see a forest on each side far away. No end to the flowers before me. I found my self inside a stage coach floating along the meadow. My Grandmother was sitting across from me, beside her was my Aunt Marie. My Grandmother hugged me. She did not speak but I understand her goodbye and my Aunts. I woke up knowing my Grandmother had passed. Unknown to me My Aunt had passed a short time prior to my grandmother. I called Ky. My Mom told me her mother, my grandmother had passed in the early hours of the morning.
She also told me my dads sister, my Aunt Marie had passed two weeks before. No one had notified us. I was able to say goodbye to both. My great grandmother passed shortly before my grandmother. I had an out of body experience. I was in my great grandmothers home looking for her. I was up high looking down. I could see everything. The house was gloomy. No lights on. The smells and her home were the same as always. My great grandmother had been taken to my grandmothers house the day before. I did not know it yet. She was too ill to care for her self. My mother was now caring for my great grandmother and my grandmother. I believe I felt my great-grandmothers distress over leaving her home. Her greatest dread. I spent a lot of time with both my grandmothers as a teenager. I always felt connected to my elders. I wanted to know all they knew of our family.
I have always been greatly interested in genealogy. Who we are is very important to me. I feel our connections are eternal. My cousin died at age thirty-six of lung cancer. Twelve years later I dreamt of Lucy, my cousin. She was smiling and radiant. Lucy held out a baby for me to look at. I could not make out the babies face. I could see he had lots of hair. I felt Lucy's thoughts. She was letting me know the baby would be well cared for, not to worry. Shortly after we learned my step-daughter had delivered a son with lots of hair. He passed shortly after his birth. I knew Lucy had let me know the baby is where he is suppose to be. I have had many experiences such as these. I also have seen places before I get to them. I recognize God has prepared me for this experience. This is how I know I am loved. I feel loved. I feel everything happens for a reason. We all have a purpose, a reason for being here. The only thing I fear about death is leaving behind my family.

I don't remember what was going on in the dream but I was outdoors at some sort of carnival and my son came up and hugged me from behind. He was just a little younger than he was when he passed, so he was at his adult height. It was just a short part at the end of the dream, but I was filled with such love and longing that it was unlike any dream I had had in the past. When I woke up and realized that he wasn't still here, I was really sad and depressed for the next day or so because the dream seemed so real.

This is a series of events.

My grandmother died of a heart attack in a hospital 10 days after a brain stroke.
She passed away on 26th Dec, and left me devastated. I was in UK when she died in India, unable to say my goodbyes because I had become a new mother that
September and baby's paperwork was not ready to leave the country and visit her in India. She died without seeing her great-grandson whom she already doted on just like she doted on me.

In a phone conversation a few days before she suffered the stroke, she pleaded with me to come and visit her and made a statement that she would die before she could see my baby. I felt sad and guilty when she said that but never thought it was a premonition.

Also a few days before her death I had a quarrel with my husband which left me really upset. I went to the bathroom and cried and that crying turned into a proper fit by the end of which I was fully clothed under a shower and screaming her name over and over. It was like I was possessed. I still am unsure whether this was me getting to know she was leaving or did I send all my bad vibes to her. But I missed my mother (grandmother) and I was screaming for her. My grandparents raised me instead of my parents and I am so grateful for that, perhaps the best thing that could happen to me.

Two/three days after her death I woke up one night to find a blinking blue light in the sitting room. The light came from the DVD reader flashing 'Goodbye'. The machine says goodbye when you are turning it off. But this was flashing sign like I had just turned it on and should actually read 'Welcome'. Any ways crazy things happen with electronics. But what I cannot disregard is the feeling that she was sitting on the sofa. I could not see or smell her but I did feel her. I was so scared that I told her to go because she was not needed here. Wow! I was so scared that I turned on her, how could I. It was almost that I had to say those words for some reason. Only yesterday I was amazed to find myself alive because I felt I had to die with her and now I had already asked her to leave when she came all that way to say her goodbyes.... so cruel of me.

Traditionally we cook for the deceased's soul and distribute to the poor but since I could not organize that I just cooked her favorite meals and put them out to the birds. I have never seen so many or such variety of birds in my patch ever. A pair of every kind, where from in that particularly cold winter on 2010.
I was so bewildered, it was as if the universe was asking me to Believe that there is something beyond and I would meet her again.

Then in the first week on January I had a dream in which she touched my hand and as she touched me I sat up in my bed (this is all a part of a surreal dream) and then she quickly retreated her steps, and as I saw her go I was helpless as I was tied down to my body, I started to cry and claw at my husband but all in vain for she went to the window in the room and turned into an orb. Then a couple of orbs joined her and the they all flew out. But this was all a dream just a very unsettling one. The next time I turned on my computer I saw the colorful orbs flying around and forming the Windows logo and it felt like dj vu.

I am not very religious especially with all that's wrong with the world today, I am also skeptical, so it takes a lot of convincing for me to believe in things.
But I do think these things over and over. I cannot let go of the feelings that pursued me around the time of her death. My soulmate had died and had not even asked about me at her time of death or seen my child. Everyone had been there with her, all the family except me, she saw them all and asked about everyone except me, they used to call me her pill, if I was near her she was always great. Later I was told that it is a phenomenon which eases ones release from the world so they forget their loved ones and are able to leave this world and move on.

Five years on I am a busy mum of two but the pain there is just neglected under the surplus chores to be done. I discovered ADCRF during my period of bereavement. Even tough I have tough time believing in things, reading and experiencing all these stories had helping me build up faith that I will meet her again, which is enough for me.

I was in my bed, in my bedroom when this happened. I was extremely sad and to relax my mind I was watching TV. Dad was in the kitchen. suddenly I saw a flash of light through the corner of my eyes. When I turned my head towards it, a shawl (woolen garment worn by Indian ladies) that was hanging on a chair was moving by itself (all the doors and windows were closed at that time). I kept staring at it with astonishment. I knew who it was.

The two days after my brother-in-law died accidentally were a complete blur of emotions. My wife and I were emotionally drained but unable to sleep except in short stretches. We ended up sitting in bed holding each other for a good part of the night.

I thought
I had finally drifted off to sleep but was awakened by the presence of something or someone else in the bedroom. I first looked at the clock and saw it was about 2:05 a.m., then turned around and suddenly saw a bluish-white form in the opposite corner of the room. It was about 4 or 5 feet high and seemed to be hovering a slight distance above the floor. A feeling of peace came over me and inside my head I distinctly heard the words "I'm all right, everything's OK.
Please take care of her." The light faded out and for the first time since the accident, I slept soundly.

The next morning I remembered what happened quite clearly, but initially thought it might have actually been a dream or possibly a hallucination-like experience brought on by grief and lack of sleep. Both my wife and I have advanced degrees in the sciences and normally aren't likely to see events in non-rational terms, so I didn't say anything to her about what had happened. Then part of the way through breakfast, she asked me if I had seen anything strange during the night. I hesitated but said yes without going any deeper. She then told me, "Well, about 2 o'clock I saw a light in the room and heard the words, 'I'm all right ...' "

Despite every bit of scientific training that tells me the events I've described could not have happened, THEY DID and TWO OF US saw them. To this day I remain convinced that my brother-in-law spoke to us from the other side. Since then, my views of death have changed somewhat. I still want to hang onto life on this plane as long as humanly possible, but when the time comes to leave, I no longer fear what awaits.

I have had three separate experiences in the past three days. I suspect that I will have more in the future.

1. The first night I spent in my father's/my room after his death. I woke up at 4:30am and was wide awake. I was looking out of the window in bed and got many different "feelings." One was strong in that I need to contact and see my father's daughter from a previous marriage (10 yrs older than me), see her children. My father had a falling out with her when she was 20-21yrs old (about 13 years ago)
and had not contacted her since. He seemed to really want me to repair the relationship. I also got a strong feeling that I was to help an illegal immigrant that had befriended my brother. Lastly, I was thinking about the age at which my father had died and how that wasn't such a bad age to go and I got an almost verbal response of "just wait until you're 56!" This response was like a thought in my head, but it wasn't my thought at all. I hope this makes sense...I didn't hear anything outloud...just internally.

2. I was again woken up at 6:30am, but I was so exhausted from the previous night, that I asked to be allowed to sleep, so I was able to relax.

3. This morning, he helped me decide on a tattoo. I have wanted to get a tattoo for about 3 years, but I was indecisive about what, and he guided me to a book in his room with a picture in it. Later, I was out on a run, on a route that my father and I both loved very much (me for running, him for biking). I saw a single great blue heron on the lake, and then it flew off. I had just been feeling much grief earlier in the run, but after seeing the great blue, there was a sense of peace.

Midday on 5/4/06, I was riding my horse (named Rooster) out on a trail ride. It was a beautiful spring day with the sun shining, blue sky, light breeze, temp. in the mid 70's.

The ride was very relaxing, and as we walked down a gently sloping hill, I felt the presence of two aunts who were dead (My Aunt Mary and Aunt Helen). I thought it strange that I felt their presence with me as I hardly ever thought of them, but
I truly felt their presence in a fleeting manner. These aunts were very close to my Aunt Julie in their younger days.

Later that afternoon, I received the news that my Aunt Julie (who lived 1000 miles away)
had been in a car accident at about the same time which I had felt the presence of Aunt Mary and Aunt Helen. Aunt Julie died a few hours after the accident. I believe that my two aunts came to escort Aunt Julie across to the afterlife.

And another coincidence: I was riding a horse named Rooster. My Aunt Julie loved roosters and had rooster statues, pictures, even kitchen curtains with roosters in her house.

I had 2 doctor appointments on this particular morning, each at a different location. My alarm woke me up at 6:30 a.m. and I was thinking to myself, I have to get to this office by 9:00 a.m. and then get to the next office by 11:00 a.m. I then fell back to sleep and immediately starting dreaming and in the dream, I was walking and saying the same thing as above. Right before me my favorite doctor appeared. It was so sudden, in the dream, it startled me and I said out loud, "Oh"! (He was not one of the doctors. I was seeing that day, but his office was at the last office bldg. I was going to.) I said to him, "Now I have to go see an oral Surgeon, then I have to go to the hand surgeon. He just stood there in green scrubs just looking at me and listening like he normally would.

I said to him, "Well, I have to get going" and I turned to leave and he said after me, "Take care of your throat!" I turned to him and said, "Now, you know I see you every 3 mos. for this, and I am also going to see the ENT and. . .I just looked at him and he was looking at me and there was a yellowish/golden fuzzy light around him. I wanted to say more, but at that moment I woke up.

This dream haunted me all day. This was a Wednesday morning. When I went to my 2nd appt. that day at his office, I had a strange feeling about him. The next day there was a message on my machine to call his office that my next 3 mos. scheduled appointment had to be cancelled. Since this was after work when I got the message I could not call his office till the next morning which was Friday. When I called, I was told that he had passed away on Wed. morning and was found early around 6:30 - 7:00 which was when my ADC of him occurred.

I saw him regularly every 3 mos. to keep track of my thyroid. I think he was telling me to take care of my throat for a different problem, which at the time was sleep apnea. I think he wanted to tell me that. I was shocked at his death along with all who knew him. He was my favorite dr. and I still miss him today.

My mother had been suffering from a heart condition and ultimately passed away from congestive heart failure after an unsuccessful heart transplant operation.
I missed my mother a lot and I remember before her funeral looking at her body and I thought how it was just a body and I wondered where my mother had gone.

I didn't realise until a few years later that in the month following her death I couldn't understand that she was gone, I would imagine that I saw her when out walking around my town only to realise that it wasn't her. I also remember how, one night over dinner with my one of my cousin's and her mother to celebrate my cousin's birthday, I realized that I would never get a chance to have this kind of relationship with my mother again. I found it so difficult to connect with my emotions but underneath the shock of my mother's passing, I was suffering. I was 18 years old and a few months later I turned 19 years old.

One night I went to sleep and I was dreaming of my home being under attack, black crows tried to enter through the windows but the windows were on springs and wouldn't stay closed unless I held them fast. This was definitely a dream and the next scene in the dream I was walking up the road where I lived and everything was calm. Suddenly, in the dream my mother appeared in front of me.
Whilst my mother was alive and due to her heart condition, she had lost so much weight she was practically skin and bone. I remember how my father would cut off the labels of her clothing so nobody would know that she wore children's clothing, that's how thin she had become.

However, my mother wasn't part of my dream, she appeared and she was young again, like how she looked in photos when she got married. Her face was full and it looked like her skin was made of light. My mother was wearing a forest green sari (she loved wearing this style of Indian clothing when she was alive). My mother didn't speak to me but she simply looked at me and she smiled.

The next thing I knew, I was awake in my bed. I remember how the sunlight was coming into my room. Suddenly, from the top of my head and all the way down through my body I felt such love, it was like being bathed in unconditional love. Afterwards I couldn't find any words to describe that love and words just seem inadequate. It is a love I have never experienced in this world, the closest I can do is say that perfect peace is perfect love.

Whilst this was happening I was aware that there were other beings or souls overlapping like discs, interconnected and endless were experiencing the same love with me and there was no separation but they were also individual but we all shared this love. There was no time, when I was 18 years old I described this experience to an Aunt afterwards and I explained that I couldn't say if it was one minute or all of eternity. I still do this day can't describe how that's possible but there was just no time.

Slowly, the experience faded and I lay blinking on my mind. What's also unusual is that I was completely calm and the whole experience felt completely natural.
It's only many years later looking back that I realized how out of the ordinary it all was.

I believe that my mother came to visit me to comfort me and to show me that she was doing just more than fine on the other side. I've never seen her look so well, she was literally glowing and a healthy weight again. She never spoke any words but her smile let me know.

People have questioned the validity of what I experienced over the years and I didn't know about NDE's, OBE's or STE's but I know that it was REAL, clear as day and I believe we do not die and that we live on.

My mother suffered from her illness for so many years, she could never play sports with other children, she could never run and after she died it broke my heart to think how much she had suffered. I know now that after she died, she was freer and happier than she had been on this earthly life and that is a great, great comfort to me. I'm forever grateful that she came to me to let me know.

I had locked myself out of my house and I had phoned my boyfriend to ask him if he could meet me there and let me in. When I arrived at the house I was aware that he had already arrived and was waiting inside for me. As I walked down the path I noticed a huge, low, orange full moon and I knocked on the door and beckoned him out to see the moon. We were standing on the path looking in awe at the moon - when my boyfriend said "WoW" What IS that smell?" Immediately I could smell the scent of daffodils, spring flowers, freesias - like I had NEVER smelt them before - and at the time it was dark and the ground was frozen solid, spring was late and there wasn't a flower in the garden. My hair was standing on end - but at the same time I had this feeling of pure joy and love, go through me - quite quickly.

My father met me at a baseball stadium. We were seated in the top row of the bleachers, high up, directly in front of a huge teleprompter. He explained to me that he did the best that he could. I kept questioning him. His head was down and he seemed regretful and just kept saying he did his best.

All my experience started one year ago, when my dad passed away after he was diagnosed with the chest cancer. I have different experience as I was watching or feeling it from other side that as we call it death. On the day of the funeral, I could not get it into my head, why everybody is crying. As i knew that this is part of our journey. But after all this I could feel that I am part of him, house is part of him, that he is all around with the big calm presence and smile, that all is fine.

He passed away at his age of 64, never interested into any spirituality or religion. I know he was living of fear of illnesses and death. Maybe anger or something else, he never speak of. But I feel, he was never ready to leave. He was shoving his presence with the broken water in the house or a smoke in the middle of leaving room.

One month after his funeral my granddad passed away, too.
At the age of 84. And he was really traditional catholic all his life.
His funeral was very peaceful.

After few months I experienced tiredness and pressure on my chest. One night my sleep was disturbed by my granddad. He approached to me, his hand stretched closed to me as he reached my dad to fade him out of me. He said to my dad:
Martin it was enough. His voice was strict but without anger.
It was like a scene in Ghost with Patrick Swayze. They where both kind of white smoke.

I am still looking for an answer as what this meant, why he had chosen me, is there something for me to learn, what should I do with this information. This topics are not really for wide public, so can't speak to anyone about it. But coincidence brought me a book from Anita Moorjany and the contact for you, so here I am with my story.

Maybe I find my answer here.
